{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders
da = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed and converted orders
da = da[(da['status'] == 'completed') & (da['converted'] == 1)]

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = da.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the results
print(f'Number of completed, converted orders after excluding QA: {len(da)}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted order in email channel: {avg_revenue_by_channel["email"]:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted order in paid_search channel: {avg_revenue_by_channel["paid_search"]:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {avg_revenue_by_channel["email"] - avg_revenue_by_channel["paid_search"]:.2f}')"}
